lede: Every video of theirs we caught in Most Popular since 27 Sep beat the channel's usual at least 2×.
src: Each chip is one video: its views on the first day we observed it in YouTube's Most Popular category charts, divided by the channel's usual (median views of its long-form videos published 7–90 days before that video). Channels under 1M subscribers; not included: news, music, sports, TV broadcasters, live streams, re-uploads.
